digest.component_or_area: CI lint enforcement for git write seams
propositions: Production bugs (3435, 3a33, 4dd2, 4c6c) resulted from store write paths bypassing canonical write seams with raw git add/commit/rm operations, including in GitHub workflow YAML (reconcile-bridge.yml).

A two-layer deterministic CI lint (Python AST + workflow/shell cwd-aware scanning) must flag all raw git mutation verbs in rebar Python and tracker-context mutations in workflows/shell, sanctioned only by inline '# raw-git-ok: <reason>' markers with mandatory reason.

The lint must detect git mutations via literal argv, local-variable list construction (including splat expansion), and opaque argv forwarding to git wrapper names; fail-closed opaque argv requires the marker.

Seam-internal modules (gitutil.run_git, event_append._run_git, txn, purge_bridge, git_adapter, _ref_lock), store-maintenance command callers, and disposable-workspace sites must be marked with reasoned markers in the bootstrap report-mode inventory before enforcement is enabled.
Failure messages must teach authors to use the canonical store write APIs (event-append/transaction/reconciler seams) rather than raw git invocations.

The lint excludes git read-only verbs (status/log/rev-parse), non-tracker git operations (remote add, worktree add, disposable sandbox repos), and captures the historical reconcile-bridge.yml bypass pattern via cwd/working-directory detection in workflow steps.
